turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress document to floor]
    C --> D[Name evaporated content]
    D --> E[Locate operative sentence]
    E --> F[Report ratio, direction, and flags]
    F --> G[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|Draft prompt| H{Mode stated or inferable?}
    H -->|No| I[Ask for mode]
    I --> H
    H -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| J[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    J -->|Gaps| K[Ask up to three questions or state assumptions]
    K --> J
    J -->|Passes| L[Compress prompt]
    L --> M{Did the cut remove specification?}
    M -->|Yes| N[Name failure and revert]
    N --> L
    M -->|No| O{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    O -->|No| P{Does the floor still pass?}
    P -->|No| Q[Return last passing version]
    Q --> R[Output contract]
    P -->|Yes| L
    O -->|Yes| R
    R --> S{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    S -->|Keep negotiating| L
    S -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| T{Execution tools available?}
    T -->|No| U[Gate stays closed]
    T -->|Yes| V[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    V --> W{Result}
    W -->|Success| X[Done]
    W -->|Floor failure| Y[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    Y --> L
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: K -> J, Y -> L
